
######## #1 Queen Sunduk (632)
[0] ¶ A Queen? Ridiculous.
[1] <map> 
[2] <place> Everyone here knows exactly how high they were born.
[3] <scene> Coronation Morning

[5] ¶ The old king is dead, and in Silla only Sacred Bone may wear the crown. The Sacred Bone men have run out. What is left is women: Dukman, her older sister, and a cousin named Seungman who is very glad 
[6] <term> Bone, as in the bone you were born with. Sacred Bone may wear the crown. True Bo
[7] ¶ Which of the three it will be is settled the night before, in a pavilion off the pond, by six men and a brazier. By morning the palace has a name, and the name has to be dressed.

    | 웃기지. 그렇지.

    | 그럼 그 사내 이름을 대 보게. 성골 사내 말일세. 기다리겠네.
[9] ¶ The corridor suddenly remembers it has somewhere else to be.

   0| Tie it tight. If I’m going to be ridiculous, I won’t be late as well.
    | 단단히 매거라. 우스운 건 그렇다 쳐도, 늦기까지 할 순 없지.

    | 화랑 김유신.

######## #2 Harmony Council (632)
[0] ¶ One night earlier. Six nobles, one brazier, and nobody stands up until they all agree.
[1] <scene> The Night Before
[2] <term> Hwabaek. It means “speaking in harmony,” which is the polite way of saying nobod
[3] ¶ Night in a small pavilion off the pond. Someone lights the small brazier. The flame is red first.
[4] ¶ It runs hotter. The flame turns blue. Only then may the session start.
[5] ¶ Each sleeve has a cup of tea and a wooden piece on a personal mat. They vote by setting the piece on either side of the cup.
[6] ¶ The Council decides by unanimity. One voice against is enough to stop a name. That is why it takes all night.
[7] <diagram> 
[8] ¶ Six seats. Yushin has none. He has a wall, and he is leaning on it, because the Marshal was invited to answer questions, not to ask them.
[9] ¶ The first count is three to three. A hung jury in silk.
[10] ¶ Three pieces go to the yes side of the cup. Three go to the no side.
[11] <diagram> 
[12] ¶ Then the names start. Somebody always tries a man first.
[13] murim{silla}:
   0| Prince Chunchu, then. His mother is royal.
    | 그럼 춘추 공은 어떻소. 어머니가 성골이오.
[14] imjong{silla}:
   0| And his father isn’t. Chunmyung’s boy is a Noble, Murim. By your own rule.
    | 아버지는 아니잖소. 천명 공주의 아들은 진골이오, 무림 공. 공의 규칙대로라면.
[15] ¶ Chunchu is not in the room. He was nine when he learned why.
[16] FLASHBACK  612
[16.0] ¶ Chunchu is nine. His father wakes him past midnight, which is normal, and walks him to the stream below the palace, which isn't. Kim Yongsu is the son of a king the Council threw out. The capital has 
[16.1] ¶ Tonight he is laying flat stones across the water by lamplight, one at a time, as if someone on the far bank were waiting for the bridge to be finished before dawn.
[16.2] yongsu{silla}:
   0| Shh. They’re working.
    | 쉿. 일하는 중이야.
   1| …No, don’t look for them. They hate being looked at. Like me.
    | ……아니, 찾지 마. 쳐다보는 거 싫어해. 나처럼.
[16.3] chunchu{silla}:
   0| Father… who is?
    | 아버지… 누가요?
[16.4] yongsu{silla}:
   0| Your grandfather sat in the big chair four years. Three counts, and the room took it back.
    | 네 할아버지가 그 큰 자리에 네 해 앉았다. 세 번 세고 나서, 방이 도로 가져갔지.
   1| That room eats the men who amuse it.
    | 그 방은 자길 즐겁게 해 주는 사람을 먹어.
   2| So— stay out of that room. Sit anywhere else. Sit on the bridge.
    | 그러니까— 그 방엔 들어가지 마. 다른 데 앉아. 다리 위에 앉든가.
[16.5] chunchu{silla}:
   0| …If not in the room, where does a person sit?

######## #5 Eight Great Clans (632)
[0] ¶ Satek. Yunbi. Jinmo. Mokli. Hae. Baek. Guk. Ahn.
[1] ¶ The Eight Great Clans run this country, and one king sits between them. Today, on the crown prince’s day, they settle nothing on the sand. They never do.
[2] <term> The eight great surnames. Not a council and not a party. Eight families, each ol
[3] ¶ The Chinese wrote the eight names down too, and got half of them wrong. That tells you how often the clans let outsiders count them.
[4] <quote> The great surnames of the country are eight clans: Sa, Yeon, Hyeop, Hae, Jin, Gu
[5] <scene> The Sand
[6] ¶ On the crown prince’s day, the court chalks a square grid in the palace yard. Four hard lines. No banners. The young men of each house step onto the grid in white.
